verdict.rationale: Mintlify's own docs describe automations that run its agent on a recurring schedule, on repository pushes, or on integration events. The agent researches, writes, and opens pull requests for review. A blog post adds pre-built automations for quick setup, so this is a first-party recurring background capability, not a one-off trigger. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of configuration and limits for schedules and triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably unattended.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate content maintenance with Mintlify automations by running the agent on a schedule, on repository pushes, or on connected integration events.
We redesigned automations for quicker setup with pre-built automations optimized for common use cases.
Learn how the Mintlify agent researches, plans, and writes documentation, then opens pull requests with proposed changes for your team to review.
